name: vllm-metax on MetaX MXMACA GPU
description: AccelMark runner for MetaX MXMACA GPUs using vllm-metax (MacaRT-vLLM). Presents MACA as CUDA-compatible via cu-bridge; no device flag needed. BF16/FP16; FP8 unsupported. GPTQ/AWQ via MACA kernels; MCCL tensor parallelism.
notes: Not yet smoke-tested. Install vllm-metax per developer.metax-tech.com (proprietary); requirements.txt adds benchmark deps only.
